**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user has data which is a list of links.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided an example of HTML and CSS to display a list of links in a condensed form using flexbox.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created HTML code with a container and link elements:
  ```
  <div class="container">
    <div class="link-container">
      <a href="#" class="link">Link 1</a>
      <a href="#" class="link">Link 2</a>
      <a href="#" class="link">Link 3</a>
      <!-- Add more links here -->
    </div>
  </div>
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created CSS code to style the links and container:
  ```
  .container {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .link-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .link {
    flex-basis: 30%;
    margin: 5px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that the code will create a container that uses flexbox to display the links in a row, wrapping them to the next line as needed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that `justify-content: space-between;` will distribute the links evenly across the row.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that each link will take up 30% of the available space and have a 5px margin around it.
